description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class which implements the LogNode interface. It filters log messages to only pass the message content to the next LogNode in the chain, ignoring other metadata like tags and priority. It is used within an Android logging framework to simplify log output for UI display.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode that filters logs to only pass messages, ignoring other metadata. It chains to other LogNodes to form a logging pipeline.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Overrides LogNode's println method to forward only the message content to the next LogNode, with a priority set to Log.NONE.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
